newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon Food, M.C. Packaging slide after results.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon Food, M.C. Packaging slide after results.

text.p: Shares of Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd and sister company M.C. Packaging (Hong Kong) Ltd fell sharply in Tuesday morning trade following poor interim earning results, brokers said.
"I think the sharp fall in their earnings triggered stop-loss selling," said Sean Li, an associate director at Amsteel Securities.
Lam Soon shares fell HK$0.08 or 13.79 percent to HK$0.50 ahead of morning close on a volume of 2.79 million shares.
M.C. Packaging shares fell HK$0.475 or 17.59 percent to HK$2.225 as 9.48 million shares changed hands.
Lam Soon Food posted an interim loss of HK$75.76 million for the six months to June 30, compared with a profit of HK$39.50 million a year earlier.
M.C. Packaging reported a 57 percent fall in interim profit to HK$30.28 million.
The two companies are controlled by Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd.
